lean.annotation: When a walk pass finds $w>0$ new targets, the next stage has $w$ fewer to recover. A zero-hit pass uses one retry. Once the retry budget expires, the circuit finishes with probability-one single-target searches. The correctness proof covers that fallback as well as the successful walk branches.
